titleEn: Maximum Total Beauty of the Gardens
title: 花园的最大总美丽值
summary: 分配至多 newFlowers 朵花；达到 target 的花园各贡献 full，未达到的花园共同贡献其最小花数乘 partial，求最大总美丽值。
insight: 先把花数封顶 target 并排序，已有完整花园固定计 full。枚举再把最大的若干未完整花园补到 target；对剩余前缀用预算尽量抬高其最小值，通过前缀和与二分找能共同抬升的元素数量。
pitfalls: 完整花园不参与 partial 最小值
未完整花园的最小值最多 target-1
花数、预算和美丽值使用 long

solutions.title: 枚举完整后缀并抬高未完整前缀
solutions.idea: 排序后最优完整花园一定来自当前花数最大的后缀。
steps: 排序并把每项 cap 到 target，prefix 求和；m 为原本未完整数量
remain 从 m 降到零，fullCost 累加把后缀补满的成本；若不超预算则计算 fullCount=n-remain
remain>0 时二分最大 p，使把前 p 个抬到 flowers[p-1] 的成本不超剩余预算；level=min(target-1,(prefix[p]+budget)/p)

code.java: class Solution { public long maximumBeauty(int[] flowers,long newFlowers,int target,int full,int partial){Arrays.sort(flowers);int n=flowers.length;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)flowers[i]=Math.min(flowers[i],target);long[] prefix=new long[n+1];int incomplete=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){prefix[i+1]=prefix[i]+flowers[i];if(flowers[i]<target)incomplete++;}long answer=0,fullCost=0;for(int remain=incomplete;remain>=0;remain--){if(fullCost>newFlowers)break;long budget=newFlowers-fullCost,level=0;if(remain>0){int left=1,right=remain;while(left<right){int middle=(left+right+1)/2;long cost=(long)flowers[middle-1]*middle-prefix[middle];if(cost<=budget)left=middle;else right=middle-1;}level=Math.min(target-1,(prefix[left]+budget)/left);}long beauty=(long)(n-remain)*full+level*partial;answer=Math.max(answer,beauty);if(remain>0)fullCost+=target-flowers[remain-1];}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maximumBeauty(flowers:IntArray,newFlowers:Long,target:Int,full:Int,partial:Int):Long{flowers.sort();val n=flowers.size;for(i in flowers.indices)flowers[i]=minOf(flowers[i],target);val prefix=LongArray(n+1);var incomplete=0;for(i in flowers.indices){prefix[i+1]=prefix[i]+flowers[i];if(flowers[i]<target)incomplete++};var answer=0L;var fullCost=0L;for(remain in incomplete downTo 0){if(fullCost>newFlowers)break;val budget=newFlowers-fullCost;var level=0L;if(remain>0){var left=1;var right=remain;while(left<right){val middle=(left+right+1)/2;val cost=flowers[middle-1].toLong()*middle-prefix[middle];if(cost<=budget)left=middle else right=middle-1};level=minOf((target-1).toLong(),(prefix[left]+budget)/left)};val beauty=(n-remain).toLong()*full+level*partial;answer=maxOf(answer,beauty);if(remain>0)fullCost+=target-flowers[remain-1]};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:long long maximumBeauty(vector<int>& flowers,long long newFlowers,int target,int full,int partial){sort(flowers.begin(),flowers.end());int n=flowers.size(),incomplete=0;vector<long long> prefix(n+1);for(int i=0;i<n;++i){flowers[i]=min(flowers[i],target);prefix[i+1]=prefix[i]+flowers[i];incomplete+=flowers[i]<target;}long long answer=0,fullCost=0;for(int remain=incomplete;remain>=0;--remain){if(fullCost>newFlowers)break;long long budget=newFlowers-fullCost,level=0;if(remain){int left=1,right=remain;while(left<right){int middle=(left+right+1)/2;long long cost=(long long)flowers[middle-1]*middle-prefix[middle];if(cost<=budget)left=middle;else right=middle-1;}level=min((long long)target-1,(prefix[left]+budget)/left);}answer=max(answer,(long long)(n-remain)*full+level*partial);if(remain)fullCost+=target-flowers[remain-1];}return answer;} };
